title: Maxwell sells Promis software to Sandia
summary: JASON tells of Maxwell sells Promis software to Sandia, about 1980s at New Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, he sold that to Sandia Labs.

plain: A speaker identified as JASON says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Robert Maxwell, a British media businessman, sold a piece of software called Promis to Sandia Labs, a US government research laboratory in New Mexico, in the 1980s. The telling is brief and does not say much more about the deal.
